0022600153.text: The Houston Rockets (5-0, first in the Southwest and first in the West) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (4-1, first in the Northwest and fourth in the West) in the seventh game of Houston's season, with the Rockets riding a five-game winning streak and Oklahoma City coming off a loss. Out for Houston are Alperen Sengun (back soreness), Reed Sheppard (back), and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Rockets lost the season series 1-2, though Houston won their most recent meeting 112-106 in Oklahoma City on February 7, 2026.
